_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates: no funding/MVRV/ETF thrust to climb into Hope and no reserve-spike/fear break to drop into Anxiety, so skilled call is hold the rung.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both non-bullish (analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION; narrative supply-on-offer caution) but narrative more distributional while analyst stays neutral-coil
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/greed and 30d momentum remain capped ~60-65 with funding near neutral and ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Thrust lifting fear/greed and momentum through 70 with funding heating (Hope) or break dropping fear/greed under 50 with rising exchange reserves (Anxiety)
